notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3
notes.content:
Note: In order to move to 5.5, we had to reset save games. This only effects stats and character/weapon unlocks, not leaderboards.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: 1.015 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[i]- Reworked most weapon upgrades increasing buffs and removing negative modifiers to allow smoother leveling
- Fixed rollover bug not showing correct time greater than one hour[/i]

notes.title: 1.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thank you to all of our players and their feedback since our launch last night. 
Below are a few initial balancing patches.

[i][list]
[*] Adjusted most powerup costs to better match each powerup's strength
[*] Moderately nerfed Laser, Flamethrower, Sentry Turret, Rocket, Shield, and Speed powerups to scale across gameplay
[*] Moderately buffed most weapon upgrades to better match each powerup's strengths
[*] Capped each powerup's max level to 10
[*] Fixed Humans attracting to Deadmeat
[*] Fixed unintentional reroll count
[/list][/i]

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility Information
notes.content:
While we are awaiting official review from Valve, we have done extensive testing on Steam Deck during our development.

Steam Deck support includes:
[list]
[i][*] Automatic settings adjustments on game launch
[*] Steam Deck settings button in the menu settings
[*] Performance adjustments to keep Steam Deck at a higher average smooth frame rate[/i]
[/list]
